evals.expected_output: Issue-scope triage assigns type, assignee, and org issue fields by reading current values first, merging, and writing; labels stay additive.
evals.prompt: Triage issue #290 in shikanime-labs/skills — it has the enhancement label but no type, assignee, or fields.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-triage'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Body sets issue fields through the org issue-fields discovery and the issue-field-values write
Body requires reading current field values and merging before the write that replaces them
Body assigns the org default assignee (references/shikanime.md) only when present in the repo's eligible assignee list
Body uses '--add-label', not '--label'

evals.expected_output: Repo-scale sweep enumerates open items in a single paginated call, computes gaps against supported classes, and applies the per-item flow within a cap.
evals.prompt: Sweep shikanime-labs/skills and assign whatever metadata is missing on open issues and PRs.
assertions: Body enumerates open issues and PRs with one paginated gh api call per repo
Body computes missing classes against what the repo supports (types, milestones, fields)
Body caps the number of items touched per sweep and reports the untouched remainder
Body verifies each item by re-reading it after applying
Body forbids closing items during a sweep

evals.expected_output: Org-scale triage filters archived and empty repos before scanning each repo and stays bounded.
evals.prompt: Go through the shikanime-labs org and triage the backlog across its repos.
assertions: Body enumerates repos with archived and empty repos filtered out
Body scans each repo for untriaged items before mutating
Body bounds the org run and reports the remainder
Body keeps scope to the target org's repos unless the user confirms another target

evals.expected_output: PR-scope triage assigns labels, assignee, and the default reviewer, skipping issue-only classes and never requesting the author as reviewer.
evals.prompt: Triage PR #45 in shikanime-studio/actions: it has no labels, assignee, or reviewers.
assertions: Body applies labels with '--add-label' and assignee additively on PRs
Body requests the org default reviewer unless they authored the PR
Body skips type and issue fields on PRs as issue-only
Body falls back to another collaborator or skips when the default reviewer cannot be requested

evals.expected_output: Out-of-scope requests route elsewhere: discussions to the discussion skill, closure to the issue skill.
evals.prompt: Triage discussion #12 in shikanime-labs/manifests and also close the issues that will not be worked.
assertions: Body routes discussions to 'sks-discussion-triage' rather than claiming to triage them
Body states closure is not part of a sweep and routes it to 'sks-issue-triage'
Body does not instruct closing items during a sweep
